tasks.subject: Task 1: Implement RightDivergeDiagonalJunction
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Produce a fully working RightDivergeDiagonalJunction class that can test-mode-check and build a diagonal junction at a given origin tile for all four flip/rotate configurations.

**Files:**
- Modify: `railbuilder.nut:3158-3192`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Build(true) returns true on a flat clear area for all four orientations
- [ ] Build(false) places rails and signals visible in-game for canonical orientation
- [ ] GetBranchEndTile, GetBranchPath, GetInboundBranchPath return contiguous chains
- [ ] No errors in AI debug log on load

**Verify:** Load AI in new game, trigger Build(true) then Build(false) for canonical orientation; observe rails and signals in-game.

**Steps:**
1. Add fields, constructor, structural stubs
2. Add temporary probe call to trigger Build(false) in-game
3. Derive Transform and TransformDir iteratively via log-based testing
4. Derive GetRails, GetBranchEndTile, GetBranchPath, GetInboundBranchPath
5. Add signal placements to Build()
6. Remove probe code and commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["railbuilder.nut"], "verifyCommand": "Load AI in OpenTTD, observe diagonal junction built on map", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Build(true) returns true for all four orientations", "Build(false) places correct rails and signals", "Path getters return contiguous tile chains", "No AI debug log errors"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Extend FourWayJunction for diagonal track
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Detect diagonal parallel-track windows in path tile arrays and attempt RightDivergeDiagonalJunction at valid locations, interleaved with straight-junction attempts.

**Files:**
- Modify: `railbuilder.nut:3507-3690` (FourWayJunction.TryBuildNearStation)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Straight junctions still built on straight track (no regression)
- [ ] Diagonal junctions attempted when consecutive path tiles form a diagonal run with parallel diagonal track
- [ ] Closest junction to station built first (diagonal and straight compete at each i)
- [ ] result.leftTile/rightTile populated from diagonal builds same as straight builds

**Verify:** Run new game with diagonal spine, observe FourWayJunction.TryBuildNearStation logs and diagonal junction built on map.

**Steps:**
1. Add _CheckDiagonalWindow helper
2. Call _CheckDiagonalWindow inside main scan loop
3. Derive and fill in flipX/flipY/rotate mapping via in-game testing
4. Commit
